status_at_write: pre_new_fit; no new Shenzhen prices opened
scope: Finite mechanism screen plus an independent GAS-Norm paper-filter benchmark on existing carbon development data. Neither is declared a publishable innovation in advance.

synthetic.unit: Q divided by E_pi Q: single-step variance exactly one
synthetic.transition: rho I + (1-rho) 1 pi^T; parameters frozen within each origin
synthetic.negative_control: same balanced X but true rho=.5 in both groups
synthetic.misspecified_scenario: primary rho with next scale multiplied by exp(-.25 sign(previous_return))/sqrt(cosh(.5))
synthetic.training_samples: independent paths, nested prefixes within each balanced X group and seed
synthetic.forecast_parameters_fitted: two group rhos (equivalent to intercept+slope logistic with binary X), or one shared constant rho; pi and scale known and fixed
synthetic.optimizer: bounded scalar rho search [0,.999], fixed 21-point grid plus local bounded refinement around lowest grid point; include endpoints
synthetic.endpoint_loss: equal mean CRPS of path sums divided by sqrt(h) at h=1,5,20
synthetic.joint_loss: endpoint_loss + .05 times forward-HMM path NLL per step
synthetic.primary_evaluation: exact population mean endpoint CRPS for each fitted model under the known Gaussian-mixture truth; no Monte Carlo for well-specified primary or negative control
synthetic.misspecified_evaluation: 200000 independent truth paths from a fixed separate seed; paired scores, diagnostic only
synthetic.market_resource_gate: At n=1024, mean of 20 per-seed (main risk / matched risk - 1) <= -.0002, main strictly wins at least 14 of 20 seeds, and mean per-seed main/constant_endpoint -1 <=0. This is an internal resource gate, not a significance/publication standard.
synthetic.failure_action: Stop this fixed persistence candidate before real-market fitting and before opening new Shenzhen prices. Complete the independently specified GAS-Norm benchmark regardless. No widening q, changing pi, relabeling another arm as the primary, or opening reserved 2024+ periods.
audits: h=1 rho-invariance and zero autograd derivative

gas_benchmark.purpose: Independent implementation of published Student-t GAS-Norm filter and a declared probabilistic carbon task adaptation; not original full-paper benchmark reproduction and not a new-model claim.
gas_benchmark.split: first is first quote of test year; val_end=first-21, val_start=val_end-125, train_end=val_start-21; train=39..train_end. Common test origins require both origin and origin+20 inside same year.
gas_benchmark.filter_observed_target: x_t^h=log(P_t/P_(t-h)), observed only at maturity t; predict x_(o+h)^h from info through o
gas_benchmark.filter_fit_cutoff: last mature training endpoint=train_end+20, strictly before first validation origin
gas_benchmark.filter_forecast: pure expected-score-zero AR propagation, not fake observations at their predicted mean; Student-t s^2 is scale^2, convert to variance by nu/(nu-2)
gas_benchmark.distribution_head: same three-component Gaussian-mixture head across all normalization arms
gas_benchmark.optimizer: AdamW lr=.002, weight_decay=.001, batch64, gradient norm clip1; all epochs run, best validation normalized CRPS including epoch0
gas_benchmark.common_scoring_unit: origin causal daily EWMA sigma times sqrt(h); same positive, parameter-independent factor across compared arms
gas_benchmark.primary_metric: CRPS in common normalized return units; equal market-year-horizon weighting, seeds averaged within each cell
secondary_metrics: price mean squared error vs random walk
selected epochs and all training validation histories
gas_benchmark.uncertainty: paired circular block bootstrap within fixed market-year cells, block40, 1999 resamples, nominal95%; no independent-market-population guarantee
gas_benchmark.additional_controls: frozen fitted normalizer distribution with no neural correction, train-only empirical standardized residual distribution, common causal daily-EWMA normal baseline; rules fixed before opening benchmark result scores
gas_benchmark.no_tuning: No validation grid search of architecture or optimizer. Numerical implementation corrections must be logged. Test scores cannot select variants.

data_policy.existing_data: Only four existing development CSVs with maximum date2023-12-29; read date column and reject2024+ before parsing prices
data_policy.new_shenzhen: Only metadata verified: PLOS author source dates2013-08-05..2022-03-11,1893 finite numeric quotes,2020=201 and2021=206; positivity not yet inspected. No price opening unless persistence synthetic resource gate passes and market implementation/protocol are separately frozen.
data_policy.2022_shenzhen: exclude incomplete year entirely; no favorable subperiod selection
data_policy.public_release: Code, protocols, aggregate metrics, literature and audits only. Raw third-party prices and per-origin reconstructions remain outside public Git.
